channel: npm install signerd (registry, NO git clone)
environment: empty directory: npm init -y && npm install signerd

R1_install.note: npm install signerd into an empty app resolved to 0.2.19 (dist-tag latest, propagated ~3 min after publish); `signerd --help` ran from the installed copy.

R2_keygen.note: keygen --keystore --passphrase-file wrote the keystore (publicKey G5MhUCV6…); refuses a 0664 passphrase file with the chmod 600 repair line (contract observed live).

R3_grant_add.note: grant-add created the 0600 grant file; future expiry accepted; the first (mistyped) destination was later refused by the daemon, not silently trusted.

R4_daemon_run.note: run bound the socket at 0600; missing --ledger refused with usage before any daemon started.

R5_real_signature.note: sign (tx build-tx -> sign --out) produced a 215-byte signed wire and seq 1; reported signature bytes equal the wire signature.

R6_dry_replay_refused.note: a --dry and a second real sign of the already-spent tx were both refused replay; the ledger grew ONLY on the first real signature (0 -> 366 bytes, dry stayed 366).

R7_ed25519_verification.note: the signed wire verified Ed25519 (numSignatures|signature|message layout, @noble/curves) against the keystore public key; a one-byte message tamper failed that same verification.

R8_policy_refusals_on_the_path.note: two refusals were observed en route and are product behaviour, not defects: a self-transfer (from==to) hit the envelope decider (refused envelope); a grant pinned to a different destination refused destination. Both named, both machine-readable, nothing signed.

limits: one machine, one account; placeholder blockhash — nothing confirmed on chain
